[[Chained Soul]]s are bound souls in [[the Underworld]] that are tormented by [[Dead Collector]]s and [[Dead Thresher|Threshers]], providing the Collectors with bodies for their [[corpse]] [[Corpse#Exploiting a Corpse|exploitation]] spells.

== Notes ==
* Chained Souls have an innate [[health degeneration]]: left on their own, they die in approximately 70 seconds and [[Spawn|respawn]] in 120 seconds.
* Similar to most other PvE foes, they only [[drop]] items the ''first'' time they die, making it nearly impossible for players to obtain loot from them in the Underworld. In contrast, they are easier to kill in the [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]], particularly in the first room.

== Trivia ==
* Some players believe these foes were introduced to reduce [[farming]].
